descriptors.name: grain size
descriptors.physical_meaning: Average diameter of grains, controls strength via Hall-Petch relationship
descriptors.rationale: Primary microstructural length scale governing mechanical properties

representation.notes: Log-normal distribution typical, mean or median value

quality.loss_reason: Collapses full size distribution to single statistic
quality.truncation_error: Distribution shape and tail information lost
quality.notes: Mean vs median choice affects interpretation

descriptors.name: grain boundary misorientation
descriptors.physical_meaning: Crystallographic angle between adjacent grains, determines boundary character and energy
descriptors.rationale: Controls boundary mobility, energy, and deformation behavior

representation.encoding: distribution histogram bins or statistical moments
representation.notes: Mackenzie distribution for random texture baseline

quality.loss_reason: Spatial correlations and individual boundary identities lost
quality.truncation_error: Bin discretization or moment truncation loses detail
quality.notes: Different histogram binning schemes yield different representations

descriptors.name: texture intensity
descriptors.physical_meaning: Degree of preferred crystallographic orientation in polycrystalline aggregate
descriptors.rationale: Quantifies anisotropy in mechanical and physical properties

representation.encoding: texture index or maximum ODF value
representation.notes: J-index or Kearns factor common choices

quality.loss_reason: Full orientation distribution function reduced to single metric
quality.truncation_error: Texture type and symmetry information discarded
quality.notes: Different textures can yield identical intensity values

descriptors.name: dislocation density
descriptors.physical_meaning: Total length of dislocations per unit volume, measures stored plastic deformation
descriptors.rationale: Indicates work hardening state and stored energy

representation.encoding: continuous positive real, often log scale

quality.loss_reason: Dislocation arrangement, character, and spatial distribution lost
quality.truncation_error: Cell structure and patterning information discarded
quality.notes: Total density ignores edge vs screw character

descriptors.name: precipitate volume fraction
descriptors.physical_meaning: Volume percentage of second-phase particles dispersed in matrix
descriptors.rationale: Determines precipitation strengthening contribution and boundary pinning

representation.notes: May include size distribution parameters separately

quality.loss_reason: Precipitate size, shape, spacing, and spatial distribution lost
quality.notes: Same fraction can arise from vastly different populations

descriptors.name: stacking fault energy
descriptors.physical_meaning: Energy per unit area of stacking fault, material-specific parameter
descriptors.rationale: Controls dislocation dissociation and deformation mechanism selection

representation.notes: Intrinsic material property, composition and temperature dependent

quality.notes: Direct physical property with unique value per condition

descriptors.name: grain boundary density
descriptors.physical_meaning: Total grain boundary area per unit volume of material
descriptors.rationale: Correlates with boundary-mediated processes like diffusion and sliding

representation.encoding: continuous positive real, inversely proportional to grain size

quality.loss_reason: Grain shape variations and topology lost
quality.notes: Redundant with grain size for simple geometries
